facts.text: The controller uses ASCII text commands Q:, M:, A:, G:, D:, H:, L: and !:
Q: returns the position/status string and !: returns B for busy or R for ready
get_position_pulses returns the controller's commanded pulse coordinate; it is not an independent encoder measurement of the carriage
For the OSMS20-85 half-step configuration one pulse is 1 um, so 1000 pulses are 1 mm
StageConfig's default software travel range is 0.0 to 85.0 mm
StageConfig says to change um_per_pulse, min_position_mm and max_position_mm when the controller or stage is configured differently
set_motion validates start and maximum speed in 1..30000 pulses/s and acceleration time in 0..1000 ms
set_max_speed_mm_s converts mm/s to pulses/s and clamps each speed to at least 1 pulse/s
The D: command carries the starting speed S, the maximum speed F and the acceleration time R
M: prepares a relative movement in signed pulses and G: starts the prepared motion
A: prepares an absolute movement in signed pulses and G: starts the prepared motion
H: starts the home/origin search and homing waits up to 120 s
L: requests a controlled deceleration stop
wait_until_idle waits at most 60 s by default
The GSC-02C can control two axes, 1 or 2
The README documents the software travel range of the OSMS20-85 configuration as 0 to 85 mm
The README states that the GSC-02C is an open-loop stepper controller whose reported coordinate is based on commanded pulses, not on encoder feedback
The RS-232 link is 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit with RTS/CTS handshaking
Every command ends with carriage-return plus line-feed

operator_required.name: configure_motion
operator_required.reason: a speed in mm/s depends on StageConfig.um_per_pulse, a constructor default (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:34-35); the controller itself only bounds pulses/s (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:394-402), so the site supplies the mm/s range of its stage

operator_required.name: move_absolute_mm
operator_required.reason: the travel range of the stage is a StageConfig constructor default (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:37-40) that the upstream says to change for another stage (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:31); the site supplies the absolute position range of its stage

operator_required.name: move_relative_mm
operator_required.reason: the allowed step depends on where the stage is inside its travel range, and that range is a StageConfig constructor default (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:37-40); the site supplies the range of its stage

operator_required.name: move_absolute_pulses
operator_required.reason: the pulse range maps to the stage travel range, a StageConfig constructor default (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:37-40); the site supplies the absolute pulse range of its stage

operator_required.name: move_relative_pulses
operator_required.reason: the allowed pulse step depends on the current position inside the travel range, a StageConfig constructor default (optosigma_gsc02c/controller.py:37-40); the site supplies the range of its stage
